description: Ruler of Eldraine's fae and a protector of its people; during the Phyrexian invasion Talion joined three witches to create the Wicked Slumber, which later endangered Eldraine and Talion's child.

being_types.note: Official set profile calls Talion ruler of Eldraine's fae.

roles_and_vocations.note: Official set profile describes both roles.

affiliations.note: Official design article identifies Talion as leader of the High Fae.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The profile places Talion's rulership and protection in Eldraine.

metaphysical_laws_and_rituals.note: Talion helped create this curse during the invasion.

citations.locator: The Characters of Wilds of Eldraine
supports: Talion rules Eldraine's fae, protects its people, and joined three witches to create the Wicked Slumber.

comparison_cautions: Fae is a fictional Magic category; do not equate it with living folklore traditions.
The curse and its consequences are set-story facts, not generic game rules.
